== Biography ==
Montgomry was born on 13 October 1760 and baptized on 16 December 1760 at Livingston, Linlithgowshire, Scotland. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1227|Abraham Glasgow]] and [[Cunningham-20925|Janet Cunningham]].<ref>"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X1R2-5FW : 11 February 2020), Abraham Glasgow in entry for Montgomry Glasgow, 1760.</ref>
